import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    
    static class BSet {
        long[] bits = new long[2]; // 128 bits = 2 * 64 bits
        
        BSet() {}
        
        BSet(BSet other) {
            this.bits[0] = other.bits[0];
            this.bits[1] = other.bits[1];
        }
        
        void set(int pos) {
            if (pos < 64) {
                bits[0] |= (1L << pos);
            } else {
                bits[1] |= (1L << (pos - 64));
            }
        }
        
        void set() {
            bits[0] = -1L;
            bits[1] = -1L;
        }
        
        boolean get(int pos) {
            if (pos < 64) {
                return (bits[0] & (1L << pos)) != 0;
            } else {
                return (bits[1] & (1L << (pos - 64))) != 0;
            }
        }
        
        void or(BSet other) {
            bits[0] |= other.bits[0];
            bits[1] |= other.bits[1];
        }
        
        void or(int pos) {
            set(pos);
        }
        
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            BSet bSet = (BSet) o;
            return bits[0] == bSet.bits[0] && bits[1] == bSet.bits[1];
        }
        
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(bits[0], bits[1]);
        }
    }
    
    static int N, cnt;
    static int[][] P = new int[7][7];
    static int iv100;
    
    static BSet init_state;
    
    static HashMap<BSet, Integer> state_id = new HashMap<>();
    static int[][] transition;
    static int[][] state_dp = new int[2][70003];
    static int[] probability_cache;
    
    static int mod_pow(long base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }
    
    static int compute_state_id(BSet bs) {
        if (state_id.containsKey(bs)) return state_id.get(bs);
        
        int new_id = ++cnt;
        state_id.put(new BSet(bs), new_id);
        BSet[] derived = new BSet[7];
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            derived[i] = new BSet();
        }
        BSet current = new BSet();
        
        // Precompute derived states
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                if (bs.get(mask)) {
                    derived[i].set(mask | (1 << i));
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Build transitions
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            current = new BSet(bs);
            for (int bit = 0; bit < N; ++bit) {
                if ((mask >> bit & 1) == 1) {
                    current.or(derived[bit]);
                }
            }
            transition[new_id][mask] = compute_state_id(current);
        }
        
        return new_id;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = scanner.nextInt();
        
        // Initialize transition table
        transition = new int[70003][128];
        
        init_state = new BSet();
        init_state.set(0);
        compute_state_id(init_state);
        iv100 = mod_pow(100, MOD - 2);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                P[i][j] = scanner.nextInt();
            }
        }
        
        // Initialize DP
        for (int i = 0; i < 70003; i++) {
            state_dp[0][i] = 0;
            state_dp[1][i] = 0;
        }
        state_dp[0][1] = 1;
        
        probability_cache = new int[1 << N];
        
        int current = 0;
        for (int stage = 0; stage < N; ++stage) {
            // Precompute probabilities for this stage
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                probability_cache[mask] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                    int prob_val = ((mask >> k & 1) == 1) ? P[stage][k] : (100 - P[stage][k]);
                    probability_cache[mask] = (int) ((1L * probability_cache[mask] * iv100 % MOD) * prob_val % MOD);
                }
            }
            
            // Clear next state DP
            for (int i = 0; i < 70003; i++) {
                state_dp[current ^ 1][i] = 0;
            }
            
            // Process transitions
            for (int s = 1; s <= cnt; ++s) {
                if (state_dp[current][s] != 0) {
                    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                        int next_s = transition[s][mask];
                        state_dp[current ^ 1][next_s] = (int) ((state_dp[current ^ 1][next_s] + 
                                1L * state_dp[current][s] * probability_cache[mask]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            current ^= 1;
        }
        
        // Target state: all bits set
        BSet full_mask = new BSet();
        full_mask.set();
        System.out.println(state_dp[current][state_id.get(full_mask)]);
    }
}
